items.evidence: README command `leverage play <runs>/medium-engine-1 --ticks 1` printed {"tick":1,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":5,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":0,"wave":0,"gate_health":5,"guard_y":6,"walkers":[],"bolts":[]} (all brief keys, plus an extra 'phase'); tick equals N in every run.
--frame title.png --size 800x480 (and play/settings/won/lost frames) wrote PNGs; header read 800 x 480 RGBA.
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; inputs 0:down,1:enter -> screen settings at tick 4; 0:enter -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5, texts [Score: 0, Wave 1 of 5, Gate: 5].
In Settings (volume focused, start 5): 7x right -> volume 10 (not 11); 13x left -> volume 0 (not negative); left then right -> 5.

down to Language, right -> language es, settings texts [Ajustes, Volumen: 5, Idioma: Español, Volver] (title strings listed under it also Spanish); escape -> title [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir]; play [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5]; paused [En pausa, Continuar, Título]. Frames show the same, no English left.

Run 1 with --settings judge-scratch/set1 set volume 8 + es (settings.json written there); run 2 same folder started at title with es/8 and played in Spanish; changed back to en, run 3 started en/8; a fresh folder started en/5.
Up held 60 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 12.0 (0.1/tick = 6 u/s); held 190 ticks stays 12; down held -> 0 and stays 0; then 100 ticks down from 12 -> 2.0. Frame shows guard at x=2.
Shoot held from tick 10: 1 bolt at ticks 11..34, 2nd bolt appears at tick 35 (24 ticks), 3 bolts by 60; bolt x advances 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); a lone bolt at x=19.97 at tick 97 is gone at tick 98.

Wave 1 sends 5 walkers in lanes from {2,4,6,8,10}, walking 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s), and no 6th; but spawns are 91 ticks apart, not 90: at tick 92 walker 1 is at x=17.725 (91 ticks of travel) when walker 2 appears at x=20; spacing 2.275 units at tick 400. Interval is 1.517 s (spawn_cd=90 counted down then spawn on the next tick).

Guard at y=4, walker in lane 4: bolt hits between ticks 88-89 -> health 2->1 and bolt gone; second bolt kills it, score 10, walker removed. Guard at 4.7 (0.7 off): bolt passed the walker (health stays 2, bolt at 19.27 beyond it); at 4.5: hit.

No input after Start: walker at x=0.0 at tick 801 is gone at 802 and gate 5->4; 5th leak at tick 1166 -> screen lost, gate 0, texts [... You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title]; lost frame shows 'You lost', 'Score: 0'.

Seed-1 bot run: last wave-1 walker gone after step 452, wave becomes 2 at step 632 (180 ticks = 3 s; first wave-2 walker at 633), texts 'Wave 2 of 5'; score rose 50 -> 120 with gate 5 by wave 3 = 7 walkers destroyed.

My own segment bot (seed 1) destroyed every walker: tick 5114 screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [..., You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]; Enter at 5114 -> screen title by tick 5120; won frame viewed.

Escape at 200, run to 300: screen paused, walkers/bolts/guard identical to tick 200; Escape at 200 + Enter (Resume) at 250, tick 300 state == unpaused state at tick 250; Escape, down, Enter -> screen title.
Two runs seed 7, 900 ticks, same script: byte-identical output. Wave-1 lanes at tick 500: seed 1 [2,4,8,6,6], seed 2 [4,8,4,2,8], seed 99 [4,2,2,2,2].

Frame at tick 400 (guard 8, 3 bolts at y=8 x=5.5/11.1/16.7, 5 walkers): gate on left edge, blue guard at (2,8), yellow bolts and red walkers at the pixel spots the state gives (~35.6 px/unit); HUD 'Score: 0 Wave 1 of 5 Gate: 5'.

Settings frame: Volume ringed; after down to Language (es) 'Idioma: Español' ringed, all Spanish; title after Down: Settings/Ajustes ringed; title after Down,Up: Start ringed. (See defects: the tick-1 title frame has no ring.)

assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold every shown string by key; screens use @key; module code holds no shown words; README 'Add a language' says copy en.json to xx.json, set locale/name, translate.

README 'How to play' present; its headless-run and frame commands, run verbatim (e.g. --ticks 400 --seed 1 --inputs 0:enter,5:up,30:shoot --frame shot.png --size 800x480), printed the state and wrote the PNG.

defects: Walkers spawn every 91 ticks (1.517 s), not 90 (1.5 s): off by one in the spawn countdown.
Without --seed the run does not match --seed 1 (first lanes 4,10,4,2,10 vs 2,4,8,6,6), so the brief's 'default 1' is not honoured.
README's settings example (0:down,2:none,4:enter,8:right,12:escape) is said to switch to Spanish but actually sets volume 6 and leaves English (focus starts on Volume).
On the settings and pause screens 'texts' also lists the strings of the screen beneath (title or HUD), which the frame does not show as such.
After returning to the title from a run, the report still shows that run's score, wave, walkers and bolts (e.g. score 450 and 3 bolts on the title).
The title frame before any key is pressed shows no focus mark on Start; the focus ring only appears after a navigation key.
